description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nittambuwa, Nittambuwa D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510607
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and encumbrances) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
